scope_label: population health loss from premature mortality and nonfatal conditions
definition: A disability-adjusted life year is a unit of health loss combining years lost to premature death with time lived in less than full health, weighted by severity.
explanation: DALYs can be added across conditions or populations to summarize a burden of disease.
The result depends on the reference life expectancy and disability weights used; it is not a direct rating of care quality.
